candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order to return 502 and gateway checkout to fail with 502 at ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/traces or deploy data; payment latency root cause (resource saturation vs config) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout ~2s, order returns 502, gateway checkout 502 at ~2s matching p95 2425ms. Inventory/redis and postgres ready are healthy. Payment-side evidence needed to confirm root cause.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and traces for /v1/authorizations during incident window
